create.name: Jenna Pfingston
create.bio:
Jenna Pfingston is a yoga teacher and embodiment guide who owns jalaBlu Yoga & Collective Healing, a small studio in Buena Vista in Colorado's Arkansas Valley. She danced from an early age and found her way to yoga through movement. She is registered with Yoga Alliance at the E-RYT 500 level and has further training as an embodied somatic coach, a primal movement guide, a first-level iRest teacher and a cacao ceremony facilitator, with more than fifteen years of guiding students behind her.

In her one-to-one sessions she works through conversation, body awareness and gentle movement, often ending in a resting shape on the floor with drumming, smudging or a guided shamanic journey where it suits. She sees people at the studio or online, for individuals and couples, starting with a short free call. At jalaBlu she also holds ceremonies, themed workshops and retreats, some of them abroad. Her YouTube channel keeps an earlier series of chakra-themed yoga classes alongside mudra and mantra meditations and retellings of Hindu stories of Shakti, Shiva and Durga. A thread through all of it is learning to trust the body's own intelligence and to work with feminine and masculine qualities as energies.

courses.title: Embodied Somatic Sessions with Jenna
courses.description: One-to-one or couples sessions held at jalaBlu in Buena Vista or online. Each one mixes conversation and body awareness with movement and rest, and may close with a guided shamanic journey. They run as a series, beginning with a free discovery call by email.

courses.title: Private Yoga Sessions with Jenna
courses.description: Personal yoga classes with Jenna at her studio or online, for one person, two, or a small group. Sessions can be shaped around what you want to explore, from movement to ceremony, and packs of four or ten are offered.

courses.title: jalaBlu Mexico Retreat (March 2027)
courses.description: A ceremony-based retreat in Mexico run by Jenna's studio, jalaBlu, with a handful of places left. A deposit holds a place; contact the studio for the full cost and programme.

free_resources.title: Jenna Pfingston on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her guided meditations and embodiment practices, drawing on yoga, mudra and mantra. Free to listen in the app or a browser.

flags: Health rule, borderline: she brands her one-to-one work 'Embodied Somatic Therapy' and the studio 'Collective Healing'; her session page mentions people arriving overwhelmed or in deep grief, a 'safe and healing space', and holding space for thresholds such as entering menopause, and a testimonial mentions anxieties. No condition is sold as treatable, so the plan is written, but the owner may prefer to skip under the strict rule.
